title: ALPR mobile research samples v2 descriptor

mt_invocation_identity.description: mt_invocation_id groups 0..N decoder detections from one actual MT backend call. Shared session, continuity stamp and ROI/input geometry; empty when NOT_RUN. subject_key retains object identity.

mt_detection_index_base.description: mt_detection_index is zero-based in decoder order; empty for NO_DETECTION and NOT_RUN.

mt_detection_order.description: mt_detection_count is identical on all child rows, including invalid quads. Zero detections produces one NO_DETECTION row with count=0; NOT_RUN has empty count. Errors and cancellations require separate treatment.
